title: Shorshe Ilish
description: Bengal's most prized dish of hilsa steaks simmered in a pungent mustard paste with green chillies and mustard oil.

ingredients.name: Yellow Mustard Seeds
ingredients.notes: soaked 15 minutes and ground with 2 green chillies and a pinch of salt

steps: Rub the fish with half the turmeric and the salt and rest 10 minutes.
Grind the soaked mustard seeds with 2 green chillies to a smooth paste, mixing in water to loosen it.
Heat 2 tbsp of the mustard oil and lightly sear the fish steaks for 1 minute each side; set aside.
Heat the remaining mustard oil gently, add the nigella seeds and the slit green chillies.
Add the mustard paste, remaining turmeric and the water and bring to a gentle simmer.
Slide in the fish, cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, spooning the gravy over; do not overcook.
